issues.title: LVMH 2.625% Notes due 7 March 2029
issues.selection_basis: Predeclared family order; issuer-linked dated final terms identify series 163, tranche 1 and the matching July 2024 base with three supplements. No classifier result used.

documents.scope_basis: Actual dated final terms for the identified issue, including unsubordinated status, fixed-rate selection, denomination and final redemption. Entire final terms searched.

PDF pages 1-35 contain the three supplements; 36-59 the base cover, description and risks; 69-126 conditions, 127 global representation, 133-139 selling restrictions, 182-189 general information and directory. Uncompleted retail/wholesale final-terms forms at 140-181 are shelf options. Other issuer/reference/proceeds material is searched as foreign context; it does not select a debt mechanism. Actual final terms select unsubordinated fixed-rate notes.

issues.source_language_qualification: English offering documents are retained. French governing law and incorporated French issuer information have not been independently reconciled as a complete legal record.
issues.dependency_boundary: The matching base and all three supplements named in the final terms are retained. Full agency agreements, subsequent amendments, incorporated issuer information and actual investor facts remain outside the verified offering-document scope.

issues.title: BBVA Series 15 5.625% perpetual AT1 preferred securities, November 2025
issues.selection_basis: Predeclared family order and dated issuer-linked series 15 circular; page 37 expressly describes the pre-conversion holder as holding a subordinated debt instrument. Identity and category selected before classifier output.

documents.scope_basis: Cover/issue disclosures, issue-specific risks and overview, capital/regulatory discussion, complete conditions, selling restrictions and general information. Bank business risks, issuer accounts/description and taxation are searched as foreign context. Both CET1 trigger conversion and capital-reduction holder-election conditions remain in scope.

issues.source_language_qualification: English offering circular with Spanish governing law; no whole-law or translation-equivalence claim.
issues.dependency_boundary: Source classification is conditional on this dated offering circular. Incorporated accounts, agency agreement, later amendments and real capital/regulatory events are not independently established. Capital-reduction conversion has an express holder opt-out and must not be presented as unconditionally compulsory.

issues.title: SEB USD500m 6.750% perpetual AT1 convertible notes, November 2024
issues.selection_basis: Predeclared family order; issuer transactions page and retained information memorandum identify the USD500m November 2024 AT1 issue. The PDF spaces its identifier as XS 2930103580. No classifier result used.

documents.scope_basis: Cover/issue disclosures, risks and overview; complete conditions; global-note provisions; Class A share rights; selling restrictions and general information. Incorporated financial figures and taxation are searched as foreign context. Automatic conversion, shares-offer settlement, regulatory write-down and conversion conditions remain in scope.

issues.source_language_qualification: Page 79 states English is the document language. English law applies with Swedish-law exceptions including condition 3, conversion and compulsory acquisition; those legal systems have not been exhaustively reviewed.
